dependencies.consumer_runtime_dependencies: None added. A consuming project may import gsap; React projects may additionally use @gsap/react, as documented upstream.

technical_guidance.api_precedence: For GSAP API behavior, plugin support, lifecycle, and version details, official pinned gsap-* skills and current GSAP docs take precedence over generic design guidance and the retained legacy reference. CEOS/project direction still governs whether animation is appropriate; accessibility and reduced-motion requirements remain mandatory.

reduced_motion.verified_guidance: Use gsap.matchMedia() for prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; reduce to duration 0 or skip animation, and call mm.revert() when disposing the media context.

cleanup.react: Use useGSAP or gsap.context and ctx.revert on unmount; separately remove event listeners created outside the context.
cleanup.vue_svelte: Scope work to the component and revert context on unmount/destroy.
cleanup.scrolltrigger: Clean up/kill triggers and refresh after layout changes that affect trigger positions.

technical_guidance.performance: Prefer transform properties; avoid layout thrash; clean up off-screen animations; refresh ScrollTrigger only when layout changes.
